graph.method: Same-net filled zones, tracks/arcs, pad copper and via annuli are unioned on each layer; plated item identities bridge layers. Reachability starts at the named GND pad. This geometric graph does not replace KiCad connectivity/DRC or physical testing.

notes: Native PCB_ARC records include start/mid/end/center/radius/sweep and native arc length; arcs are not approximated by endpoint chords.
Ground connectivity uses KiCad TransformShapeToPolygon for native curves, compatibility verified separately in native_arc_helper_compatibility.json.

Implementation preference (not a user-specified fabrication rule): arc centerline radius >= trace width, with 0.0001 mm lower-bound allowance for native three-point radius recovery after coordinate rounding; larger-than-target radii are permitted, and actual signed deviations and ratios are retained in the report.
Each arc endpoint must meet one same-net/same-layer/same-width track at the exact saved coordinate and maintain tangent continuity within 0.05 degree.
